title: Homeowners Insurance Cancellation Terms Schedule
content:
Four figures of each HomeShield program govern a cancellation of Homeowners Insurance requested by the insured: the free-look period, the short-rate penalty, the minimum earned premium, and the time within which return premium is paid.

## Schedule

| Program | Free-look period after the effective date | Short-rate penalty on unearned premium after the free-look period | Minimum earned premium on an insured cancellation | Return premium paid within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 10 calendar days | 10 percent | 25 percent of the term premium | 15 calendar days |
| HomeShield Standard | 10 calendar days | 10 percent | 25 percent of the term premium | 15 calendar days |
| HomeShield Plus | 15 calendar days | 10 percent | 25 percent of the term premium | 15 calendar days |
| HomeShield Preferred | 15 calendar days | 10 percent | 15 percent of the term premium | 15 calendar days |
| HomeShield Premier | 30 calendar days | 5 percent | 15 percent of the term premium | 15 calendar days |
| HomeShield Estate | 30 calendar days | 5 percent | 10 percent of the term premium | 15 calendar days |

## Definitions used in the schedule

- **Free-look period**: calendar days after the effective date within which the insured may cancel for a full refund.
- **Short-rate penalty**: a penalty, as a percentage of the unearned premium, when the insured cancels after the free-look period.
- **Minimum earned premium**: the least premium earned on an insured cancellation, as a percentage of the term premium.
- **Return premium paid within**: calendar days after cancellation within which return premium is paid; 15 days in every program.

## Minimum earned premium in dollars

**Illustration (hypothetical term premium of 2,000.00 dollars).**

| Program | Minimum earned premium percentage | Minimum earned premium (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Standard | 25 percent | 500.00 |
| HomeShield Preferred | 15 percent | 300.00 |
| HomeShield Estate | 10 percent | 200.00 |
